sloka: समुत्पाट्य गिरेः शृङ्गं समृगव्यालपादपम् ।जघान हनुमान् वीरो राक्षसौ कपिकुञ्जरः ।। ५.४६.३५।।।।
transliteration: samutpāṭya gireḥ śṛṅgaṁ samṛgavyālapādapam ।jaghāna hanumān vīro rākṣasau kapikuñjaraḥ ।। 5.46.35।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, a courageous and mighty elephant among the monkeys uprooted a mountain peak along with its animals, serpents and trees and killed both the demon generals.
